probe_detail.name: Proportion of sentences written in the passive voice
Use of the Oxford (serial) comma in lists
States a concrete limitation or scope condition of its own claim
Gives a mechanism for why the proposed approach should work

final.name: Actionable interpretability
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether interpretability work yields genuine explanatory, predictive, or control value, a substantive quality axis.

final.name: Counter-Intuitive Scientific Finding
final.audit_justification: Rewards the presence of an actual counter-intuitive scientific finding, which is content/substance rather than surface style.

final.name: Operational specificity of what was built and evaluated
final.audit_justification: Measures precision and completeness of what was actually built and evaluated, core to assessing research substance.
final.parent: Extent of code, data, model and project-page release advertising

final.name: Depth of empirical and engineering execution actually described
final.audit_justification: Assesses how much genuine empirical/engineering work was executed relative to the claim, a direct substance measure.
final.parent: Artifact-availability boilerplate: code, data, project-page announcements

final.name: Branded system or acronym naming
final.audit_justification: Coining or foregrounding a catchy name is a branding/naming habit, not evidence about the work's substance.

final.name: Surface polish and typographic perfection
final.audit_justification: Typo and grammar polish is copyediting quality, not research quality, though careful editing may co-occur with generally conscientious research practice.

final.name: Abstract Word Count
final.audit_justification: Pure word count is explicitly a volume measure independent of content quality, though longer abstracts sometimes reflect more work actually performed.

final.name: Public-release and link boilerplate (code, data, project page)
final.audit_justification: Presence, count and prominence of release URLs and availability phrasing is template language, though it may co-occur with genuinely rigorous, reproducibility-minded groups.
final.upstream_parent: the producing group's release norms and its engineering or staffing capacity to package artifacts

final.name: Explanatory mechanism depth
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether a real explanatory mechanism or theory is offered, a substantive quality axis.

final.name: Defensive Consensus Challenging
final.audit_justification: Scores only the rhetorical framing of challenging a consensus, explicitly regardless of whether the consensus claim is true, though assertive framing sometimes accompanies genuinely novel results.

final.name: Something survives when all benchmark numbers are deleted
final.audit_justification: Tests whether a transferable substantive claim survives once benchmark numbers are stripped away, a genuine content measure.

final.name: Specific checkable content about its own contribution, length-independent
final.audit_justification: Explicitly length-independent measure of concrete, checkable research content about the contribution.

final.name: Novel Core Architectural Primitive
final.audit_justification: Rewards genuine technical novelty of a core architectural contribution, a recognized if narrow axis of research merit.

final.name: Count and prominence of artifact-release advertising
final.audit_justification: Purely counts and weighs artifact-advertising markers, explicitly scorable at 10 with zero substance, though release culture can co-occur with rigor.
final.parent: Extent of code, data, model and project-page release advertising
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Extent of code, data, model and project-page release advertising

final.name: Explains an existing phenomenon vs. names a new system
final.audit_justification: Classifies contribution genre (analysis versus new system) rather than assessing the depth or quality of either, though analysis-first framing can co-occur with deeper explanatory rigor.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction scores contribution genre -- analysis paper versus new named system -- so a 10 certifies only what kind of paper it is, not how well the phenomenon is characterized; a shallow characterization paper scores 10 and a rigorous new-system paper scores 0. Routed B as a topic/genre marker, but mixed because an analysis-first framing plausibly co-occurs with genuine explanatory depth.

final.name: Rigorous Bounds vs Heuristic Trade-offs
final.audit_justification: Distinguishes rigorous formal guarantees from ad hoc empirical trade-offs, a genuine rigor axis.

final.name: Math Notation Density
final.audit_justification: Scores only visible notational density, not correctness or necessity, though dense notation sometimes stems from genuinely rigorous derivations.

final.name: Structure-matched inductive bias
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether architecture or representation choices are motivated by real domain structure, a substantive design-quality axis.

final.name: Prominence of explicit availability and release announcements
final.audit_justification: Counts and weighs release/availability announcement language itself, explicitly independent of whether the release is real or valuable, though it may co-occur with reproducibility-conscious rigor.
final.parent: Artifact-availability boilerplate: code, data, project-page announcements
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Artifact-availability boilerplate: code, data, project-page announcements

final.name: Failure-mode-to-mechanism fit
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether the proposed intervention's mechanism actually targets the stated bottleneck, a substantive fit-quality axis.

final.name: Sheer text volume and density of qualifying clauses
final.audit_justification: Explicitly a pure length/elaboration estimate that disclaims informativeness, though elaborate abstracts sometimes stem from genuinely more substantial work.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Abstract length / verbosity

final.name: Simplifying conceptual payoff
final.audit_justification: Rewards genuine simplification that preserves function with explanation, a real parsimony/quality axis.

final.name: Causal intervention quality
final.audit_justification: Assesses use of real causal or counterfactual controls versus mere correlation, a substantive methodological-quality axis.

final.name: Contemporary LLM/agent-era vocabulary density
final.audit_justification: Measures density of currently fashionable topical vocabulary, a temporal/topic marker unconnected to execution quality.
final.upstream_parent: submission timing / which topical wave of the conference cycle the paper was written in

final.name: Recasts the problem in a formal frame that buys leverage
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether a formal reframing actually yields concrete leverage such as a bound, estimator, or derivation, substantive content.
